claim_boundary: This catalog is engineering guidance and source-design evidence. It does not claim regulatory compliance, certification, attestation, penetration-test approval, production operation, customer acceptance, or bank acceptance.

environment_model.purpose: Fast deterministic development and focused proof

environment_model.data_boundary: Synthetic or explicitly approved masked data

controls.title: Repository, source-control, and change governance
controls.risk: Unreviewed or untraceable change can reach a protected release or strand unique truth.
controls.applicability_condition: All governed repositories.
local_expectations: Use feature branches, small meaningful commits, synthetic data, and safe repository hygiene.
ci_expectations: Enforce protected-branch checks, secret scanning, clean release trees, and exact source/build identity.
production_expectations: Deploy immutable approved artifacts with auditable approval, rollback, and emergency-change history.

controls.title: Architecture boundaries and domain ownership
controls.risk: Duplicated domain truth and dependency inversion make financial behavior unsafe to change and operate.
controls.applicability_condition: All repositories; rules vary by repository role.
local_expectations: Keep domain/application logic framework-independent and side effects behind explicit ports.
ci_expectations: Reject forbidden imports, dependency cycles, persistence-model leakage, and obsolete package paths.
production_expectations: Runtime trust and data boundaries match documented ownership and deployment responsibilities.

controls.title: Secure development lifecycle and threat modeling
controls.risk: Security requirements and abuse paths can be missed until late review or incident response.
controls.applicability_condition: All repositories, with depth proportional to data, privilege, exposure, and change risk.
local_expectations: Maintain threat boundaries and negative security tests for material changes.
ci_expectations: Run governed SAST, secret, dependency, IaC, and security-requirement checks with expiring exceptions.
production_expectations: Monitor security-relevant failure and reassess threats after material incidents or architecture changes.

controls.title: Identity, authentication, and authorization
controls.risk: A valid identity can perform an unauthorized action or cross an object, tenant, portfolio, or service boundary.
controls.applicability_condition: Any user, service, operator, or privileged action boundary.
local_expectations: Use isolated synthetic identities and test allow, deny, expiry, wrong-scope, and wrong-owner behavior.
ci_expectations: Prove deny-by-default policies and reject production-enablable local bypasses.
production_expectations: Integrate bank-approved IAM, least-privilege workload identity, access review, rotation, and privileged-action audit.

controls.title: Secrets, keys, and configuration
controls.risk: Credentials leak or production starts with unsafe, incomplete, or development-only settings.
controls.applicability_condition: Any configurable repository or runtime.
local_expectations: Use dummy examples, ignored local secrets, and value-safe startup validation.
ci_expectations: Scan secrets and validate required production settings without printing values.
production_expectations: Use bank-approved secret injection or workload identity, scoped rotation, and fail-closed configuration.

controls.title: API security and contract governance
controls.risk: Consumers receive undocumented, incompatible, unsafe, or unbounded API behavior.
controls.applicability_condition: Repositories exposing or consuming APIs.
local_expectations: Run deterministic APIs with schema validation, bounded lists, safe errors, and correlation context.
ci_expectations: Validate OpenAPI, compatibility, security declarations, errors, size limits, and idempotency semantics.
production_expectations: Enforce TLS, identity, authorization, host/CORS/body limits, timeouts, abuse controls, and deprecation policy.

controls.title: Event, messaging, file, and batch processing
controls.risk: Duplicates, late data, poison input, replay, or partial failure cause silent loss or double processing.
controls.applicability_condition: Asynchronous, event, file, scheduled, or batch workloads.
local_expectations: Test duplicate, out-of-order, malformed, poison, restart, and checkpoint behavior with synthetic inputs; assert the exact governed event, file, topic, partition, and idempotency identity used by the runtime.
ci_expectations: Validate schemas, producer/consumer compatibility, logical-to-physical routing identity, retry/DLQ, exact-identity replay, reconciliation, and causation identity.
production_expectations: Govern topics/files, retention, ordering, bounded retry, DLQ, lag, replay authorization, and reconciliation.

controls.title: Data protection, classification, lineage, and retention
controls.risk: Sensitive or derived financial data is over-collected, leaked, untraceable, or retained incorrectly.
controls.applicability_condition: Any repository handling business, personal, portfolio, transaction, telemetry, document, or model data.
local_expectations: Use synthetic data, deterministic resets, classification, source-safe logs, and traceable lineage fields.
ci_expectations: Scan fixtures/evidence, validate schema/migration/lineage, and test stale, inconsistent, retention, and deletion behavior.
production_expectations: Apply encryption, least privilege, residency/egress controls, lineage, retention, archive, and governed deletion.

controls.title: Financial calculation, rule, and decision reproducibility
controls.risk: A financial figure or governed decision cannot be reproduced, explained, corrected, or reconciled.
controls.applicability_condition: Financial calculations, eligibility, suitability, scoring, simulation, or governed decision rules.
local_expectations: Use Decimal-safe types, explicit dates/time zones/rounding, deterministic clocks, and readable golden cases.
ci_expectations: Block unintended golden-output changes and test precision, FX, calendars, corrections, backdating, and version replay.
production_expectations: Retain source inputs, methodology/configuration versions, overrides, warnings, publication state, and reconciliation.

controls.title: Audit logging and business traceability
controls.risk: Sensitive actions, decisions, corrections, overrides, and publication cannot be reconstructed safely.
controls.applicability_condition: State changes, privileged operations, financial decisions, publication, replay, or manual intervention.
local_expectations: Use explicit audit schemas, synthetic actors, and tests for success, failure, denial, and redaction.
ci_expectations: Validate mandatory audit events, correlation, change summaries, append-only abstraction, and fail behavior.
production_expectations: Use protected audit storage, restricted access, monitored delivery, retention, and investigation export.

controls.title: Observability, logging, metrics, tracing, and supportability
controls.risk: Technical or business-processing failure is discovered late or cannot be diagnosed without sensitive data access.
controls.applicability_condition: All runtime or operational automation surfaces.
local_expectations: Expose structured source-safe telemetry, correlation, health semantics, and documented local inspection.
ci_expectations: Test telemetry schema, redaction, bounded labels, correlation, probes, operations, dashboards, and alerts as code.
production_expectations: Centralize controlled telemetry, define service indicators, alert on user/data impact, and link alerts to runbooks.

controls.title: Resilience, reliability, and graceful degradation
controls.risk: Dependency failure, overload, duplicate work, or restart produces unsafe retries, false success, or unreconciled state.
controls.applicability_condition: Runtime dependencies, concurrent work, or stateful workflows.
local_expectations: Simulate slow/unavailable dependencies, malformed responses, concurrent duplicates, partial failure, and shutdown.
ci_expectations: Test timeout budgets, bounded retry/backoff, degradation, concurrency, and recovery without flaky sleeps; readiness must prove the exact governed resource or work identity rather than any unrelated row or aggregate.
production_expectations: Size pools and limits, prevent retry storms, expose dependency health safely, and reconcile after recovery.

controls.title: Testing strategy and quality gates
controls.risk: A change passes superficial checks while weakening business, architecture, security, contract, or recovery proof.
controls.applicability_condition: All repositories.
local_expectations: Expose fast deterministic focused and PR-grade repository-native commands with synthetic readable fixtures.
ci_expectations: Run the applicable test pyramid, contract, architecture, security, migration, golden, and coverage gates with governed quarantine.
production_expectations: Use safe post-deploy smoke, synthetic monitoring, recovery exercises, and production-configuration validation.

controls.title: CI/CD, SBOM, build provenance, and artifact integrity
controls.risk: A released artifact cannot be traced, verified, assessed for vulnerability impact, or safely promoted.
controls.applicability_condition: Any packaged, published, or deployable artifact.
local_expectations: Use lock files and controlled toolchains; reproduce artifact format and SBOM generation where practical.
ci_expectations: Build cleanly, record source/builder/inputs, generate SBOM and provenance, scan, sign, and verify before promotion.
production_expectations: Deploy by digest, verify provenance/signature, restrict registries, and map deployed versions to component inventories.

controls.title: Container and runtime hardening
controls.risk: A deployable image includes unnecessary attack surface, privilege, mutable inputs, secrets, or missing runtime assets.
controls.applicability_condition: Containerized deployable services and workers.
local_expectations: Separate development and production targets, control base images, use dockerignore, and avoid embedded credentials.
ci_expectations: Lint, build, scan, inventory, and smoke the final production image including declared entrypoints and shutdown.
production_expectations: Run immutable non-root images with least privilege, bounded resources, read-only posture where feasible, and restricted egress.

controls.title: Bank-hosted deployment and workload policy
controls.risk: Deployment configuration permits development bypasses, excessive privilege, uncontrolled network access, or unsafe upgrades.
controls.applicability_condition: Services intended for Kubernetes or equivalent bank-hosted deployment; local Kubernetes is optional unless this behavior is under test.
local_expectations: Render and validate deployment templates locally with synthetic identity and low resource requirements.
ci_expectations: Validate schemas, probes, security policy, configuration references, bypass exclusion, and upgrade/rollback posture.
production_expectations: Use bank-controlled identity, namespace, ingress, TLS, secrets, network, pod security, resources, rollout, and egress policy.

controls.title: Database, cache, and persistence controls
controls.risk: Persistence defects cause silent corruption, unauthorized access, unsafe migration, or unrecoverable state.
controls.applicability_condition: Repositories owning durable data or correctness-relevant cache behavior.
local_expectations: Provide deterministic migration/reset, synthetic seeds, model separation, and transaction/concurrency/cache tests; derive destructive cleanup dependencies from the authoritative schema relationship inventory and execute cleanup atomically.
ci_expectations: Run clean and compatibility migrations, repository tests, destructive-change review, locking, indexes, and cache correctness; mutation tests must fail when a newly related durable child is omitted from cleanup.
production_expectations: Use least privilege, encrypted connections, pooling/timeouts, monitoring, backup, controlled migrations, and data-change audit.

controls.title: Performance, capacity, and scalability
controls.risk: Correct behavior misses latency, throughput, batch-window, saturation, cost, or recovery expectations.
controls.applicability_condition: Critical APIs, calculations, jobs, user journeys, or high-volume integrations.
local_expectations: Profile representative synthetic workloads and document volume assumptions rather than optimizing tiny fixtures.
ci_expectations: Run stable performance smoke, bounded pagination/batch/memory/concurrency checks, and record environment variance.
production_expectations: Define targets, monitor percentiles/throughput/saturation, enforce back-pressure, and revalidate before material rollout.

controls.title: Backup, restore, disaster recovery, and business continuity
controls.risk: State is backed up but cannot be restored, reconciled, failed over, or recovered within an agreed objective.
controls.applicability_condition: Stateful or continuity-critical runtime capability.
local_expectations: Version and test safe export/import, restore, or replay logic with synthetic state.
ci_expectations: Validate recovery tooling, schema compatibility, source safety, and runbook commands in controlled integration.
production_expectations: Agree RPO/RTO, protect isolated backups, exercise restore/failover/failback, reconcile, and retain remediation evidence.

controls.title: Release, deployment, rollback, and change evidence
controls.risk: A release cannot be promoted, observed, or reversed predictably with current migration and configuration state.
controls.applicability_condition: Any versioned release or deployment.
local_expectations: Version changes, document migration/configuration impact, and test upgrade paths without mixing unrelated risk.
ci_expectations: Produce protected release evidence, verify digest/signature, enforce required gates, and render deployment dry runs.
production_expectations: Use approved identity, progressive rollout where needed, pre/post checks, rollback triggers, prior artifacts, and outcome audit.

controls.title: Vulnerability management and penetration-test readiness
controls.risk: Known weaknesses remain unowned, unexpired, unmapped to deployed versions, or falsely represented as externally approved.
controls.applicability_condition: All repositories, with external testing based on deployment and customer risk.
local_expectations: Expose security scans and fix root causes; keep debug/test surfaces isolated.
ci_expectations: Scan changes/releases, block governed severity, deduplicate findings, expire exceptions, and produce test-scope inventory.
production_expectations: Map vulnerability intelligence to deployed SBOMs, meet governed remediation paths, retest, and preserve restricted evidence.

controls.title: Incident response and operational support
controls.risk: Service, security, or data incidents lack predictable detection, containment, recovery, communication, and corrective-action closure.
controls.applicability_condition: Operational or released capabilities.
local_expectations: Provide source-safe diagnostics, correlation-based investigation, common failure guidance, and synthetic exercises.
ci_expectations: Validate runbook links, alert contracts, version/support metadata, and incident-relevant telemetry and audit.
production_expectations: Define severity, contacts, escalation, containment, rollback, rotation, reconciliation, evidence preservation, and review.

controls.title: AI, model, retrieval, and agent-tool governance
controls.risk: Model behavior, data egress, prompt injection, unsupported claims, or tool actions exceed evidence and human authority.
controls.applicability_condition: Any LLM, embedding, retrieval, classification, recommendation, narrative, or agentic tool surface; otherwise Not applicable.
local_expectations: Use synthetic data, deterministic fakes, versioned prompts/models/policies, structured outputs, abuse tests, and human approval.
ci_expectations: Run groundedness, domain, refusal, citation, injection, tool, failure, provenance, and sensitive-data evaluations.
production_expectations: Use approved endpoints, minimized data, governed retention/egress, bounded tools, monitored quality, safe degradation, and rollback.
owner_roles: model risk or product control owner

controls.title: Frontend and Workbench controls
controls.risk: A user interface leaks data, misrepresents stale or partial analytics, bypasses approval expectations, or excludes supported users.
controls.applicability_condition: User-facing web, report, document, or advisor/operations product surfaces.
local_expectations: Use synthetic personas, source/as-of/status truth, backend-failure states, accessible interactions, and safe session storage.
ci_expectations: Run component, browser, accessibility, entitlement, degraded-state, CSP, and upload/download tests as applicable.
production_expectations: Use secure sessions/headers, controlled external assets, performance/error monitoring, action audit, and explicit approval/publish states.

controls.title: Documentation, runbooks, and procurement evidence
controls.risk: Reviewers cannot locate current implementation truth or are given unsupported readiness, compliance, or certification claims.
controls.applicability_condition: All repositories; depth follows repository role and evidence maturity.
local_expectations: Document supported startup, commands, synthetic data, troubleshooting, ownership, and limitations in the correct documentation layer.
ci_expectations: Validate links, structures, contracts, claims, required runbooks, and source-safe evidence summaries.
production_expectations: Maintain architecture, operations, security, data, release, incident, recovery, support, and exit evidence with access controls.
